scripts.build:docker: docker build --build-arg CAP_VERSION=$(grep -E '^CAP_VERSION=' .env 2>/dev/null | cut -d'=' -f2 | xargs -I {} sh -c 'if [ "{}" = "latest" ]; then git ls-remote --tags --refs https://github.com/tiagozip/cap.git | grep -o "refs/tags/standalone@[0-9.]*" | sort -V | tail -n1 | cut -d"@" -f2; else echo "{}"; fi' || echo '3.1.11') -t tiago2/cap:standalone@$(grep -E '^CAP_VERSION=' .env 2>/dev/null | cut -d'=' -f2 | xargs -I {} sh -c 'if [ "{}" = "latest" ]; then git ls-remote --tags --refs https://github.com/tiagozip/cap.git | grep -o "refs/tags/standalone@[0-9.]*" | sort -V | tail -n1 | cut -d"@" -f2; else echo "{}"; fi' || echo '3.1.11')-themed .
